subject.title: feat: add tools.fs.roots — per-agent filesystem roots with access modes

question: Should `tools.fs.roots` become the supported public filesystem-root policy in core and Plugin SDK after the read-denied and explicit-root widening blockers are fixed?
rationale: The branch adds a new public configuration and SDK surface that changes host filesystem access boundaries across media/channel delivery, which requires owner intent beyond mechanical repair.

options.title: Land after security-policy fixes
options.body: Keep the feature direction, require the two host-read blockers to be fixed, and merge only after owner review of upgrade and operator semantics.

options.title: Narrow the public surface
options.body: Remove or defer the Plugin SDK/config exposure and keep any remaining repair internal until the long-term filesystem policy is settled.

options.title: Pause or close for a smaller design
options.body: Close or pause this broad branch in favor of a narrower canonical issue/PR for configurable media roots and filesystem policy.

recommendation.title: Land after security-policy fixes
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, require the two host-read blockers to be fixed, and merge only after owner review of upgrade and operator semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Most recent history around media access plumbing and fs-policy alignment points to this owner for the cross-channel media/security decision.
